units.source_text: 这一天有许多游览车装饰得比平时更加华丽，

en.t: On this day many sightseeing carriages were decorated even more splendidly than usual,

units.source_text: 许多如花如玉的美眷拥挤在车中，

en.t: and many beautiful ladies, lovely as flowers and jade, crowded inside them,

units.source_text: 竞把衫袖裙裾在帘下露出来。

en.t: competing to let their sleeves and skirt hems show beneath the blinds.

units.source_text: 源氏大将大都漠然地经过，不加注意。

en.t: General Genji usually passed by indifferently, paying them no attention.

units.source_text: 但有时也认识这是他的情人某某的车子，便对它微笑顾盼。

en.t: But sometimes he would recognize one as the carriage of some lover of his, and then he would smile and glance toward it.

units.source_text: 葵夫人的车子特别触目。

en.t: Lady Aoi's carriage was especially conspicuous.

units.source_text: 源氏大将经过时，态度非常郑重，他的侍从人等也都肃然起敬。

en.t: When General Genji passed it, his manner was extremely solemn, and all his attendants also grew respectfully grave.

units.source_text: 相形之下，六条妃子全被压倒，

en.t: By comparison, Lady Rokujo was completely overshadowed,
and in the depths of heartbreak, she silently recited:
